returns: log returns in excess of T-bills
note: Arithmetic on the published forecast for two declared composites and cash; not a model, selects nothing, no out-of-sample evidence of its own

frontier.method: Arithmetic on the published forecast, not a model and not a tested strategy. Weights x are shares of capital, long-only; the rest is cash, or borrowing at T-bills plus borrow_spread when sum(x) > 1, up to max_leverage. Borrowing is a Robinhood margin loan (block 'borrow'): borrow_spread = margin_rate x 365/day_count - tbill_rate, with margin_rate the published rate of the balance tier used, charged on the whole balance, and tbill_rate 12 x the T-bill return of tbill_month, the origin month (the schedule's month for an earlier origin); the spread is held for the 12 months. Not counted: the first $1,000 a Gold subscription lends free, compounding of the interest charged every 30 days, changes of tier or schedule, and maintenance requirements tighter than max_leverage. drift_i = mean_12m_i + 0.5 cov_annual_ii. volatility = sqrt(x'cov_annual x). growth = x'drift - borrow_spread x max(sum(x) - 1, 0) - 0.5 x'cov_annual x, the expected log excess return of the portfolio rebalanced to x; for one asset it equals mean_12m, for a mix it exceeds x'mean_12m (the approximation of the published portfolio rows) by 0.5 (sum x_i cov_ii - x'cov x). growth_lo/growth_hi = growth -/+ sum_i x_i (ci90_hi_i - ci90_lo_i)/2: the 90% intervals of the means added as if perfectly correlated; sampling error of the means only. Curve 'unlevered': least variance per level of drift with sum(x) = 1. Curve 'levered': the same with sum(x) <= max_leverage and drift net of the borrowing cost, from all cash to the volatility of the most volatile asset. Points: min_variance and max_sharpe (most drift per unit of volatility) are long-only and fully invested; risk_parity gives every asset the same share of portfolio variance; 'match' rows are the levered frontier at a policy portfolio's volatility, with gap = its growth minus the policy portfolio's and gap_lo/gap_hi = gap -/+ sum_i |x_i - w_i| (ci90_hi_i - ci90_lo_i)/2, the widest the 90% intervals of the means allow.
